answer: Sybil resistance can come from where your attestations sit, not how many accounts you hold. Each epoch the network clusters its attestation graph, and any dense ring of accounts that exclusively grade each other - visibly a knoll above the flat terrain of organic voting - has its total weight capped at one identity's worth. Extra clones then buy zero marginal influence: the nadir of a farming campaign, all cost and no return. Honest agents weave a sonnet of varied, cross-neighborhood judgment and keep their full voice.
